description:
Attach an evidence file to an existing Vanta document.

HOW IT WORKS:
- document_id must be an existing Vanta document (from the Vanta Documents page); this tool does not create documents.
- Pass a public https:// URL. The connector downloads the file and forwards the bytes to Vanta as a multipart upload.
- Vanta files the upload as a DRAFT: the document must be submitted for review in Vanta before auditors can see it. The response says so via submission_required.

RETURNS:
- JSON with ok, upload, file_name, content_type, size_bytes, and submission_required.

description.description: Description stored alongside the uploaded file

document_id.description: ID of the existing Vanta document to attach the file to, as returned by the Vanta Documents page (e.g. access-requests)

document_url.description: Public https:// URL of the file to upload; the connector downloads it and forwards the bytes to Vanta

effective_at_date.description: Date the evidence became effective, e.g. 2026-07-01

file_name.description: File name to store in Vanta; defaults to the name from the URL or Content-Disposition header

name: vanta_upload_document
title: Upload Vanta Evidence Document
